unsavedDialog.title: Unsaved Changes
unsavedDialog.description: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave? Your changes will be lost.

noProfileYet.greeting: Hey {{name}}, let's build your personal brand
noProfileYet.heroSubtitle: Your marketplace profile is your <bold>professional identity</bold>. It's how clients discover you, learn about your expertise, and choose to book with <bold>you specifically</bold>. Stand out from the crowd and attract the clients you want.
noProfileYet.showcaseDescription: Tell your story and highlight what makes you unique
noProfileYet.publicProfileHint: How clients will see you on the marketplace
noProfileYet.publicProfileDescription: A complete profile helps clients understand your skills, experience, and personality. Profiles with photos and detailed bios receive <bold>3x more booking requests</bold>.
noProfileYet.getDiscoveredDescription: Clients search for professionals by specialty. Your profile helps them find exactly what they're looking for—<bold>you</bold>.
noProfileYet.buildTrustDescription: Your profile, combined with reviews, creates credibility. Clients book with confidence when they know who you are.
noProfileYet.successDescription: Every booking starts with a client discovering your profile. The more complete and compelling your profile, the more clients will choose <bold>you</bold> over others. Start building your professional presence today.

profileTab.basicInfoDescription: Your public identity on the marketplace. Choose a display name and title that represents you professionally.
profileTab.aboutMeDescription: Tell potential clients about yourself, your experience, and what makes you unique. A great bio helps build trust and attract the right clients.
profileTab.aboutMePlaceholder: Share your experience, skills, and what makes you unique...
profileTab.languagesInterestsDescription: Share the languages you speak and your personal interests. Let clients get to know you beyond your professional skills.
profileTab.socialLinksDescription: Connect with clients beyond the platform. Add your social media profiles and website to build your personal brand.
